verdict: Zero leads this period — a tracking break, not an ad problem.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Google Ads campaigns delivered 131 clicks on $621.80 in spend but recorded zero leads — the data confirms this is a conversion tracking or landing-page form failure, not an ad performance issue. Separately, 49 direction requests came through your Google Business Profile, showing real local demand that no call path is currently capturing. The end-to-end stack is being re-tested today (August 31) and paid landing pages are going live this week, which directly addresses both the tracking break and the missing call path. Once tracking is restored and verified, expect conversion data to reflect actual intake activity — the pipeline already shows 172 contacts in the system, so demand is present.
